events.event_name: CookUnity — The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Bari Bodega, 873 Broadway; Madison Square Deli, 266 W 23rd St; New York Pizza and Cafe, 369 Madison Ave; Sam's Deli, 275 W 4th St; Slice N' Spice, 451 Third Ave
events.what_it_is: A one-day CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas with eight celebrity and internet-famous chefs serving complimentary chef-made meals and hot samples.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary CookUnity meals or hot bites while supplies last, plus a bodega-style scratch-off ticket with prize opportunities.
events.caveats: Meals and hot samples are while supplies last; current coverage expects substantial lines. No advance RSVP requirement is published.
events.practical_notes: Thursday Sept. 17 only, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM. Five locations: Flatiron, Chelsea, Midtown, West Village and Murray Hill.

events.event_name: Bobbi Brown — The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 9th Avenue between 14th and 15th Streets, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown newsstand activation for Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ with sampling, refreshments, scratch-off giveaways and a mirrored photo moment.
events.what_is_free: VEFB+ sample, grapefruit Spindrift, mini croissant and scratch-off giveaway while supplies last; the first 100 guests are advertised to receive a deluxe-size sample.
events.caveats: Samples, refreshments and prizes are while supplies last. Multiple current listings describe the activation as open to the public; no advance RSVP is established as required.
events.practical_notes: Thursday Sept. 17, noon–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle, 9th Avenue between 14th and 15th Streets.

occurrences.details: Walk-in at any of five Manhattan bodegas; complimentary food while supplies last.
Free public beauty newsstand activation; samples, refreshments and giveaways while supplies last.
